item_name: Genuine G.I. Type Sun, Wind & Dust Goggles
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Sun, Wind & Dust Goggles offer superior eye protection against harsh outdoor elements. These versatile goggles come with 2 interchangeable non-ballistic lenses—grey and clear—that can be easily swapped out and securely fastened with stud snap fasteners. The tactical goggles are constructed with a durable rubber frame, featuring dust covers that provide added protection from debris. The foam interior is designed for long-lasting comfort, ensuring a snug fit during extended wear.
description: Rothco’s Sun, Wind & Dust Goggles offer superior eye protection against harsh outdoor elements. These versatile goggles come with 2 interchangeable non-ballistic lenses—grey and clear—that can be easily swapped out and securely fastened with stud snap fasteners. The tactical goggles are constructed with a durable rubber frame, featuring dust covers that provide added protection from debris. The foam interior is designed for long-lasting comfort, ensuring a snug fit during extended wear. Made from mildew-resistant cotton flannelette material, these goggles are built to withstand the elements while maintaining comfort. The adjustable elastic strap allows for a customized fit, making them perfect for a wide range of outdoor activities and field missions.
